text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Egyptian President Mubarak visits Amman after talks with Syrian President Assad; King Hussein and Mubarak discuss eliminating obstacles in Middle East peace process.
- King praises Egyptian efforts to jump start Israeli-Palestinian talks and stresses support of Palestinian quest to attain national rights.

- Jordanian and Israeli officials discuss peace developments during one-day visit by Israeli Foreign Minister Levy which also tackles expanding bilateral ties; monarch stresses need to "stop policies which hold back progress in Middle East peace talks".
- Amman is centre of hectic political diplomacy to activate Middle East peace process; Jordanian-Egyptian summit at Amman airport is preceded by Egyptian-Syrian talks in Damascus.
- King says Israeli Foreign Minister Levy left "positive impression" during his Jordan talks.
- Private sector allowed to import cigarettes as of mid-August.
- Government to replace sugar, rice and powdered milk subsidies delivered via coupon system with cash handouts.
